meta.name: security-owasp-agentic
meta.description: Review an agentic AI system against the current OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications categories, including ASI01 Agent Goal Hijack, ASI02 Tool Misuse and Exploitation, ASI03 Identity and Privilege Abuse, ASI04 Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities, ASI05 Unexpected Code Execution, ASI06 Memory and Context Poisoning, ASI07 Insecure Inter-Agent Communication, ASI08 Cascading Failures, ASI09 Human-Agent Trust Exploitation, and ASI10 Rogue Agents. Produces per-category status, autonomy budget, tool inventory with least-privilege scope, abuse-case eval results, kill-switch verification, and a release-gate verdict. Use for any system where an LLM-driven agent reads, writes, calls tools, plans, or coordinates other agents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 OWASP 十大智能体风险逐项审查你的 AI 智能体系统,产出各风险项状态、自主操作预算、工具权限清单、滥用测试结果、急停开关验证和是否放行的结论。
howto.when: 当你要求对会读、写、调用工具或调度其他智能体的 LLM 系统做上线前安全检查时触发。

say.text: 按 OWASP Top 10 审查一下我的 agent 系统
say.note: 它会逐项给出状态和证据

say.text: 帮我验证这个 agent 的急停开关是否有效
say.note: 它会运行一次急停演练并记录结果

say.text: 检查我的 agent 工具权限是否满足最小权限
say.note: 它会输出带权限范围的工具清单

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude audits an agentic AI system against the OWASP Top 10, returning per-risk status, autonomy budget, tool inventory with least privilege, abuse-case results, kill-switch verification, and a release verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a pre-release security review of an LLM system whose agent reads, writes, calls tools, plans, or coordinates other agents.

say_en.text: Review my agent system against the OWASP Top 10.
say_en.note: It returns status and evidence per category.

say_en.text: Verify whether this agent's kill switch actually works.
say_en.note: It runs a kill-switch drill and records the result.

say_en.text: Check whether my agent's tool permissions follow least privilege.
say_en.note: It outputs a tool inventory with scopes.
